name: Bypassed Affection
source:
Graduation has come for Ivy, and with it the final knell in her gradual estrangement from her roommate and best friend, Lilac. In the midst of her rumination, a mysterious figure calling themself a god offers a chance to peer into her memories... 

[From [url=https://starryeyedess.itch.io/bypassed-affection]itch.io[/url]]
